pr_body:
- When the WebApplications's application name is specified we need to set the it on the internal web host builder so that hosting startups can see the new name. This allows the logic to find hosting startups in the specified application name instead of the entry assembly. When running inside of test projects, the entry assembly is always the test host, that's why it showed it when running tests.
- Added tests

Fixes #35956

issue_context.title: In-app IHostingStartup instances are not discovered/run when --applicationName is passed via args to WebApplication.CreateBuilder, e.g. from test projects
comments: This is a bug with how early we observe the name specified by the host. We're not observing it in time for the logic that looks at hosting startup to find it in the application assembly instead of the entry assembly.
I wasn't able to repro this in a 3.1 app. Trying 5.0 now.
Doesn't repro in 5.0 app either. Trying a 6.0 app that doesn't use `WebApplication`
Doesn't repro there either. Seems to be just a regression in behavior with the new `WebApplication` API.
